title: CamStack addon deploy executor
description: Pack + upload an addon to a running CamStack hub.

server.description: Hub base URL (e.g. https://hub.example.com:4443). Falls back to $CAMSTACK_SERVER, ~/.camstackrc, then http://localhost:4443.

token.description: Auth token (Bearer). Prefer leaving this unset and reading from $CAMSTACK_TOKEN or ~/.camstackrc — don't bake secrets into project.json.

skipBuild.description: Skip the `build` target dependency and pack whatever is already on disk. Useful for iterative pack-only debugging.

packOnly.description: Run `npm pack` but skip the upload — emit the .tgz path to stdout. Useful in CI when the upload step is gated on a downstream approval.

keepTarball.description: Keep the .tgz after a successful upload (default: delete). Useful for archive/audit.
